procedural_matters: The race officer presented the request for redress on behalf of ‘Place to Be’ 5564.
The case was heard under RRS 63.1(b). As ‘Place to Be’ was still racing in the Rund Bornholm race at the time of the hearing.
facts: ’Place to Be’ and ‘Dockenhuden’were racing in the Rund Bornholm race.
’Place to Be’ left the raceto rescue ‘Dockenhuden’ and towed her into Tejn on Bornholm.
’Place to Be’ passed thenorth Bornholm waypoint at 10:28 hrs. for the first time before rescuing ‘Dockenhuden’. She passed the waypoint again at 14:07 hrs. again after the rescue.
At 10:28 hrs. the wind was282 degrees 11 kts., and at 14:07 hrs. the wind was 253 degrees and 10 kts.
conclusions: ’Place to Be’ went to therescue of 'Dockenhuden' as required by RRS 1.1.
‘Place to Be’ took 219minutes to rescue 'Dockenhuden' return to the north Bornholm waypoint as exemptedby RRS 42.3(g).
During that time the windhad decreased and adversely changed direction.
The race officer calculatedthat ‘Place to Be’ should be compensated by 219 minutes + 22 minutes.
decision: ‘Place to Be’ 5564 to have 4 hours 1 minute deducted from her elapsed time.
